Dedup-checks by name via LinkedListSearchByName; when absent, parses the scene data (SceneDataParser), resolves the current scene entry from the scene array (base dword_8AC490, index dword_8AC48C, stride 396), allocates and initializes a 24-byte scene node block, copies two strings out of the scene entry, wraps the block in a 12-byte list node, appends the node to the head/tail list at this+0x10/+0x14/+0x18, increments the node count at this+0x1C, and returns the node found by name (the newly inserted one).

Only proceed when the resolved scene data entry pointer is non-null.

Copy the scene entry name string (entry+260) into the new node with StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.
Copy the scene entry secondary string (entry+4) with StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.
Only link the node when the 24-byte scene block was actually allocated and initialized.
Allocate a 12-byte list node with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper; initialize its payload pointer to the scene node, forward link to 0 and a byte flag to 1.

Append the new list node: when the list head this+0x10 is non-null, point the previous tail's link (this+0x14 dereferenced at +4) at the new node; otherwise set head this+0x10 and secondary pointer this+0x18 to the new node.
Advance the list tail this+0x14 to the new node and increment the node count this+0x1C.
Return LinkedListSearchByName(this, a2), resolving to the newly inserted node or to the pre-existing node when the dedup guard skipped insertion.
